annotations.title: Who writes a line in a state

description: Who actually writes a line of insurance in a state: companies ranked by direct premium written where the regulator publishes every company (CA, TX, IL, NC, SD, WI), otherwise the licensed companies; the directory page for the state and line is the source to cite. Use it to tell someone which insurers are real markets for their need in their state before sending a quote request.

line.description: Line of business, e.g. workers comp, homeowners, commercial auto, general liability, surety
